AggregatedInputs.why: reads other blocks' values and reports across them -- itNAMES the inputs it aggregates and nests none of them

AnswerDistribution.why: reports how a cohort answered the item it names

Carousel.why: its BODY is a comma- or newline-separated list of ids. Itcontains nothing syntactically, which is why a nesting-onlyscan called it childless across eight files

Chat.why: turns and cast presentation, and it NESTS structure whileREFERENCING the items a turn works on; the student's ownresponses are the Chat's value, not its children

Collapsible.why: a foldable region; items inside are optional detail

Course.why: the top level; carries sections, not items directly

DynamicList.why: a repeating row the student can grow

Hidden.why: present but not rendered until something reveals it -- whichis where Navigator's template blocks are defined

LiquidTemplate.why: templated presentation, and it wraps whole banks

MasteryBank.why: its body lists item ids and repeats them until `goal` is met-- a container whose contents are named, never nested

Navigator.why: `preview=` and `detail=` name template blocks by id, and itsbody carries its own YAML-ish entry list: data, not children

NextReveal.why: one turn at a time, revealed on advance

Noop.why: a transparent wrapper -- holds whatever it is given

Ref.why: names blocks by id and renders their value. It HOLDS almostnothing and REFERENCES almost everything -- 431 TextAreareferences alone -- and it is the mechanism by which anLLMAction reads a response

Sequential.why: ordered steps revealed one at a time

Cast.why: declares characters as data, and nests the TeamDirectory that presents them -- found in a documented example, not in any .olx

SharedNotes.why: a shared surface; UNDEMONSTRATED as a parent

SideBarPanel.why: two named regions marked by MainPane and Sidebar, stubblocks the parent parses rather than components in their ownright

SplitPanel.why: two regions side by side; UNDEMONSTRATED as a parent in thecorpora scanned

SplitTest.why: selects among variants; UNDEMONSTRATED -- appears in no .olxin the corpora scanned

Tabs.why: parallel pages; items sit inside the page bodies

TimedContainer.why: content under a clock -- the reason Freewrite appears insideone

UseDynamic.why: renders dynamically-produced content, nesting structure andnaming the items it fills in

UseHistory.why: names a block and renders that student's earlier values

Vertical.why: the general-purpose page body -- the container that holdsANYTHING, and the one an intake program should default towhen nothing more specific is implied

leaves.AvatarEditor: an editor; its value is the figure, not children
leaves.NavigatorDefaultPreview: a Navigator template, named by attribute
